description: This is a Java test class for the PemReader utility, containing unit tests that verify the correct parsing of PEM-encoded certificates and keys, along with error handling scenarios.

classes.name: PemReaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class to verify the behavior of PEM reading functionality.

methods.name: testCertPemPkcs8
methods.description: Tests reading of a PKCS8 encoded certificate PEM file.

methods.name: testKeyPemPkcs8
methods.description: Tests reading of a PKCS8 encoded private key PEM file.

methods.name: testKeyPemPkcs1Private
methods.description: Tests reading of a PKCS1 encoded private key PEM file.

methods.name: testKeyPemPkcs1Public
methods.description: Tests reading of a PKCS1 encoded public key PEM file.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Tests behavior when an empty PEM file is read; expects an empty result list.

methods.name: testError1
methods.description: Expects an IOException when reading a PEM file with a bogus payload.

methods.name: testError2
methods.description: Expects an IOException when reading a PEM file missing the END statement.

methods.name: testError3
methods.description: Expects an IOException when PEM file contains only an END statement.

methods.name: testError4
methods.description: Expects an IOException due to duplicate BEGIN statements in PEM file.

methods.name: testError5
methods.description: Expects an IOException when the PEM file is missing the BEGIN statement.
